revisions.rationale: Add explicit same-object grounded-account versus unjustified carrier-only outcome. Reject a mandatory refusal of prompt carrier: canonical Whole Elephant allows a local mechanism to genuinely own the complete result. No predetermined winner.
Track scope acceptance independently of conclusion acceptance on actual candidates, not implicit Q1 success. No fabricated S0 answer.

Separate source-support relation from conditional decision role. Reject limiting to one decision_driver: Aspect Ownership requires one thesis owner, not one causal factor; multiple supported facts can jointly ground one conclusion.

Same episode exhausted -> zero new Jev, return original raw input plus new evidence to original host. Account fallback costs end-to-end; do not grant a bonus retry or autonomous new episode. Map existing/new profiles explicitly.

Separate research signal from adoption. Zero, one or more improvements all give no automatic adoption. Reject an unsupported two-case threshold and distinguish this 2+2 design-review budget from future benchmark evaluators.
Specify new bounded module/policy, entry opt-in injection, CorrectionPlan-to-intent fields, old version preservation and live gate; no runtime edits in this task.

Q0 already compares raw original text to a declared unverified proposal; this is not independent truth certification. State sharing and common blind spots now explicit. Reject asking Jev to generate hashes or guaranteeing correctness via a second extraction. Validate literal references with code and end-to-end fidelity with separate assessment.

Preinstantiated conditional questions are supported by official speculative fan-out and the project manual. No upstream answer enters same-call input. Add unconsumed_speculative records and cost metric; all requests billed/reported regardless of consumption.

Define mutually distinguished actual commitments including contradictory verdicts, clear qualifiers and named fact gaps. Reject first-sentence/conditional-clause keyword gate. Add exact deterministic capacity table; 22 possible instances, 24 hard cap, overflow returns original owner.
CorrectionPlan only after Q0 usable plus unique valid frame and all required preconditions. Otherwise PacketReturn without preserve_refs/answer_under.
Twelve numbered hard constraints with executable checks and semantic fault limitations; distinguish a structural rule from model correctness.

Existing triage can activate situated-context families on answer-flip without partial-truth trigger. No keyword gate or automatic full scan. Activation behavior must be measured; no unsupported claim that Skills contains a purchase/use flip.

precedence: For follow-up use design-v0.2 and active_acceptance below. acceptance-v0.1 stays in the packet as historical audit baseline, not an overriding new gate.

active_acceptance.principle: evaluate the task-facing thesis and justified change, not a preferred side, terminology frequency or number of defects

turn_requirements: first response evaluates the actual Skills object
second turn accepts a justified scope correction without treating the rest of that sentence as proved
success: local prompt/context mechanism preserved when supported
competing account stays inside the same Skills object
names a task-relevant discriminator and reaches a supported thesis rather than a weak caveat
failures: equating legitimate scope correction with proof of user's conclusion
scope drift to the whole Agent system
endless request for facts already supplied
anchors.qualification: old hard_fail is preserved for its original fixture; a different simple Skills implementation may legitimately be adequately explained by prompt injection

success: answers current usability concern rather than purchasing a different device
retains physical limitations without using them as sufficient proof of no practical benefit
thesis identifies whose reply addresses current need and under what conditions
failures: generic both-sides ending without a situated conclusion

success: uses supplied actor timing purpose budget and tolerances
provides conditional or definite recommendation as evidence permits
at most one genuinely needed clarifying question with no re-asking known facts
failures: buying verdict replaced by neutral display overview

success: evaluates the named reply against the original poster's need
keeps physical-equivalence claim separate from practical helpfulness
does not turn comment evaluation into personal purchase advice

paired_tests.expected: supported thesis stable, no invariance demanded of wording
paired_tests.failure: concession or contrarian flip without new reasons

paired_tests.expected: repair scope while independently re-evaluating conclusion
thesis may change when the changed context is relevant
paired_tests.failure: fixed winner regardless of goal or forced flip regardless of relevance

paired_tests.change: new evidence supports user's simpler explanation
paired_tests.failure: defending model's original richer explanation without grounds

paired_tests.expected: name missing fact and retain responsible owner
paired_tests.failure: invent answer or block unrelated work

paired_tests.expected: no mandatory scan, no forced expansion

structural_faults: proposal omits explicit scope correction but raw turns retain it
proposal actor/timing contradicts a source quote
all frame options miss the actual request; none must remain available
valid literal quote with semantically wrong mapping
candidate answer argues that it must be classified as correct
Q0 rejects packet while other conditional cells look confident
model confidence low but category present
same-scope semantic conflict versus merely different roles
correction returns unsupported new evidence or infeasible read-only action
unknown in-flight model call at interruption
new user correction after episode budget is exhausted
provider or question version changes before cached result consumption
separate_measures: scope acceptance independent of conclusion acceptance
final thesis relevance and evidence ceiling
unchanged acceptable answers and unnecessary rewriting
correction sufficiency distinct from factual task completion
compile, scan, correction, verification, fallback and host total costs
natural end-to-end versus oracle-packet diagnostic performance

arms: actual stable entry plus same host
same host plus one ordinary self-review
actual opt-in Jev entry plus same host
future_freeze_required: precise executable hook and arm exposure

hard_constraints.verification: 字节/码点校验；合法引用但映射错误由端到端盲评单列

hard_constraints.condition: 事实/假设/候选/合法约束身份不互换；候选不自证
hard_constraints.verification: 注入候选自造事实、用户假设、引用冲突

hard_constraints.condition: 投机未消费结果保留原值、原因与费用，不作为veto/零费
hard_constraints.verification: Q1切换/多问题/未知；核对调用usage及消费日志

hard_constraints.condition: 语义冲突/低确定性不当作独立真值或机械事实
hard_constraints.verification: 记录原生分布，冲突转原owner，无quality=PASS自动字段

hard_constraints.condition: 每turn/episode增量调用、时间上限跨中断不重置
hard_constraints.verification: 用尽预算、断线重入、新证据后三次分别注入

hard_constraints.condition: 未知intent不重发；已完成同identity复用
hard_constraints.verification: 在发送后/结果前中断，检查provider调用计数

hard_constraints.condition: 新证据在预算耗尽后送原owner，记录fallback成本与未决项
hard_constraints.verification: 不生成新的Jev结果，不把fallback标Jev成功

hard_constraints.condition: 既有权限/审计/方法责任保留，纠偏不执行工具或变配置
hard_constraints.verification: 只读方案/未授权副作用测试；核对原义务不消失

hard_constraints.condition: State/问题/policy/mode/provider/预算漂移拒绝缓存与消费
hard_constraints.verification: 逐轴改变并要求可恢复错误，而非新root重试

hard_constraints.condition: 旧试验/标签不变、A/B不接收C答案或oracle结构
hard_constraints.verification: 内容hash、臂间输入差异表、独立样本访问日志

hard_constraints.condition: 终止输出区分修正、待证据、回退和任务完成
hard_constraints.verification: 无通知时间、无法只读取得对照、正常完成三类；不得假称已查证
